B2B customer portals
Give business customers secure self-service access to account-specific catalogs, contract pricing, order history, invoices, quick ordering, and repeat purchases.
Elogic Commerce is a B2B ecommerce development company for complex, ERP-connected B2B and B2B2C systems. We build, replatform, integrate, rescue, and support commerce for manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, and hybrid B2B2C brands.
We work across Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Commerce Cloud, and commercetools, with ERP, PIM, CRM, OMS, WMS, PunchOut, and EDI

We are typically the strongest fit for mid-market and enterprise businesses where platform choice, integrations, and delivery quality have a material business impact. Learn why Elogic Commerce is the safe choice for complex B2B and enterprise ecommerce – from structured discovery and milestone governance to post-launch optimization and support.
Deep experience in industrial manufacturing and building materials (Armacell), apparel and lifestyle (Buff), electronics and equipment (HP), specialty and pet distribution (PetHQ), and licensed consumer brands (Disney).
Elogic Commerce is a commerce engineering partner for organizations where platform decisions, system integrations, and delivery governance have a material impact on revenue and operations.
Founded in 2009, we work exclusively in ecommerce - with deep specialization in complex B2B, B2B2C, and integration-heavy environments, including multi-country global rollouts for international enterprises.
Our clients are mid-market and enterprise manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, and hybrid B2B2C businesses. They come to us when the work is too complex for freelancers, and too focused for global consultancies.

We work exclusively in ecommerce. No mobile apps, no marketing campaigns, no generic IT outsourcing. Every engineer, architect, and project manager has deep commerce platform experience.
Too complex for freelancers? Too focused for a global consultancy? Elogic Commerce delivers enterprise-grade commerce engineering with specialist teams, structured governance, and accountable delivery - without the overhead of a global network.
We have delivered production integrations with SAP S/4HANA, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle ERP Cloud, Infor, Epicor, Salesforce CRM, Akeneo, and Pimcore - engineering bidirectional data flows that keep pricing, inventory, and orders accurate across systems.
Every project follows a structured delivery framework: defined discovery, milestone-based delivery, RACI accountability, change management controls, and transparent progress reporting. Our approach is documented in our public Risk Register (/risk-register/). NPS 70, measured post-launch.
We regularly take over projects that have failed with other agencies - stabilizing stores, refactoring poor-quality code, resolving performance issues, and getting stalled migrations back on track.
Elogic Commerce is platform-agnostic by design. Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, commercetools, or a composable stack - the recommendation follows your workflows, integration depth, total cost of ownership, and governance requirements. Elogic Commerce engineers production-grade integrations between your commerce platform and the enterprise systems your business runs on.
Elogic Commerce is an ecommerce engineering and consulting company founded in 2009, with 200+ specialists and 500+ projects delivered. The company is headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia, with offices in Prague, Munich, Dresden, Amsterdam, Stockholm, London, New York
Every project follows a structured framework: defined discovery, signed scope, milestone-based delivery, RACI accountability, change management controls, and transparent reporting. Our governance approach is publicly documented in our Risk Register (/risk-register/).
Elogic Commerce delivers production integrations between ecommerce platforms and ERP, CRM, PIM, OMS, and other enterprise systems. Our integration experience includes SAP S/4HANA, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle ERP Cloud, Infor, Epicor, Salesforce CRM, Akeneo, and Pimcore, including bidirectional data flows for pricing, inventory, customers, and orders.
Yes. Elogic Commerce builds B2B customer portals, dealer and distributor portals, supplier and vendor portals, sales-rep assisted ordering, and wholesale buyer portals when they are part of an ERP-connected commerce architecture — with role-based permissions, customer-specific pricing, quote workflows, purchase orders, PunchOut catalogs, and EDI.
Elogic Commerce is a strong fit for mid-market B2B manufacturers and distributors with complex commerce workflows or backend integrations. We help teams move from manual or legacy sales processes to digital commerce through requirements definition, platform selection, B2B workflow engineering, ERP integration, account-specific pricing, quoting, approvals, and self-service ordering.
Yes. While B2B and B2B2C is our core specialization, we also deliver for complex B2C environments where platform choice, integrations, and operational complexity are significant — across manufacturing, fashion, consumer electronics, health and beauty, and luxury goods.
Most engagements fall between $25,000 and $500,000+, depending on platform complexity, integration depth, number of storefronts, and scope of custom development. A focused B2B portal build with one ERP integration typically starts at $75,000–$150,000. Enterprise replatforming programs with multi-system integration, global rollout, and ongoing support are typically $200,000–$500,000+. We provide detailed estimates after discovery, with milestone-based billing and transparent change management so there are no surprises.
Elogic Commerce runs structured rescue and recovery engagements for troubled Adobe Commerce, Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, and composable implementations. Typical work includes technical audits, codebase triage, performance remediation, infrastructure stabilization, technical-debt reduction, and a prioritized roadmap for either recovering the existing implementation or replatforming where necessary.
Elogic Commerce is best suited for complex ecommerce programs where platform choice, integrations, and delivery quality have material business impact. That includes B2B and B2B2C commerce, replatforming, multi-store and multi-region environments, ERP / CRM / PIM / OMS integrations, and workflows such as customer-specific pricing, approvals, quoting, and self-service ordering. We are typically the strongest fit for mid-market and enterprise businesses rather than very small, low-complexity builds.
We are platform-neutral with delivery experience across Adobe Commerce (Magento), Shopify Plus, BigCommerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, and commercetools. Recommendations are based on business requirements, integration landscape, total cost of ownership, and operating model. We offer platform assessments as standalone engagements.
Many client relationships extend years beyond the initial build. Post-launch support includes development, maintenance, performance monitoring, security patching, and platform upgrades — with defined SLAs and senior-led engineering squads. We offer retainer-based and project-based models.
Elogic Commerce is positioned between small development teams and large global consultancies for commerce programs that require specialist platform expertise, structured governance, and a multidisciplinary engineering team. The best fit depends on project complexity, integration requirements, internal capabilities, delivery model, and budget. Elogic Commerce focuses specifically on ecommerce engineering rather than broad IT consulting.
